events.evidence: The Bank of Japan lowers interest rates in Japan to a range of between 0 and 0.1%
Mexico issues its first ever 100-year bond, raising US$1 billion in a day
A state of emergency is declared after three people are killed and 120 injured by chemical sludge from an alumina plant flooded out of a burst dam in western Hungary

label.note: BOJ easing and Mexico bond supportive, offset by disasters and local violence.
